title: [DE] Support registration numbers in E-Documents
summary: E-Document import and export processing now handles registration numbers for vendor matching and supports German FC tax identifiers in multiple document formats.
key_points: Registration No. is now the last fallback when matching vendors on imported E-Documents
German FC tax identifiers are supported in XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL exports
The receiving company's Registration No. on import is checked against Company Information
E-Document, vendor and Company Information tables and pages were extended
Tests added for Registration No. vendor matching and for XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exports
quote: add Registration No. as the final fallback when matching imported E-Document vendors
